item.title: The Chronicles of Riddick: Assault on Dark Athena review (2009)
item.content:encoded: Dear diary, today I gutted 200 men.

item.title: I feel like my screenshots are coming to life through the oil paintings created by ArtbyEri
item.content:encoded: Art imitates virtual life.

item.title: Last Flag, the multiplayer shooter from the Imagine Dragons guy, is free to play for every weekend until its first update comes out
item.content:encoded: "We wanted to give everyone who hasn't had a chance to check out Last Flag the opportunity to play for free!"

item.title: Infinite monkey butts: Scriptorium's comedic take on Pentiment's inky art style is a medieval riot
item.content:encoded: Making everything out of anything is a lot of funny fun.

item.title: Shapez 2 leaves early access with a new game mode all about building massive factories: 'This isn't just a game is finished release'
item.content:encoded: Manufacture mode "addresses one of the biggest feedback points we got during early access".

item.title: Bloodlines 2's first DLC arrives next week, and it'll let you wield guns and melee weapons properly, unlike the base game
item.content:encoded: The DLC will offer a "new take" on the Brujah clan.

item.title: As Enter the Gungeon celebrates its 10th anniversary, its creators have some choice words for the modern roguelike: 'We’re seeing it mutate to the version of itself that popularity obfuscates'
item.content:encoded: "So few people are trying to make something that is truly evocative of this experience of playing Rogue".

item.title: Modder brings playable Halo Elite to Warhammer 40K: Space Marine 2
item.content:encoded: Wort wort wort.

item.title: South Korean prime minister celebrates Crimson Desert: 'K-games can shine as a pillar of K-content'
item.content:encoded: Crimson Desert takes the throne as the best K-game (Kliff game) of all time.

item.title: A minor Fallout: New Vegas quest got its own ending slide because the team was transfixed by the choice where you make the NCR's worst soldiers take Psycho
item.content:encoded: Who you callin' Poindexter?

item.title: Assassin's Creed producer assures fans 'there WILL be blood' in the Black Flag remake, and it won't be DLC
item.content:encoded: Assassins bleed.

item.title: I played the Lord of the Rings RPG where Frodo can straight-up die and the game just keeps on going
item.content:encoded: Which would have made for a different book, I think.

item.title: New Steam Controller reportedly $99
item.content:encoded: Premium price? Definitely. Premium product? We'll see.

item.title: I finally like Diablo 4 now, and it's because I embraced laziness
item.content:encoded: It's still no Path of Exile, though.

item.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer release date leaked on Steam
item.content:encoded: Watto ya gonna do?

item.title: WoW came back from the brink because Blizzard ran it like a live service game—but now that same tactic's threatening everything
item.content:encoded: It might be time for Blizzard to slow down.

item.title: Most MMOs have so many expansions, it's hard to keep track of them all—can you tell our clever fakes from the real ones?
item.content:encoded: Do you know your shapes from your warcrafts?

item.title: Epic keeps jamming more incredible shotguns into Fortnite, and it might be the best meta ever
item.content:encoded: The Chaos Reloader, Iron Pump, Dual Hammer and Super Shredder are an awesome foursome.

item.title: People love buying weapons so much in this gun store sim that I'm making bank even though I only sell brass knuckles
item.content:encoded: No guns? No problem. Any weapon is a best seller.

item.title: Menace's first major early access update overhauls its least interesting faction and jettisons its reviled promotion tax system: 'We have done away with it'
item.content:encoded: Who doesn't love a rebate?

item.title: With Silent Hill 2's source code still MIA, a dedicated fan has decided to restore the game's CGI renders: 'Takayoshi' Sato's work was incredible for its time'
item.content:encoded: Konami lost the game's original code prior to releasing the HD Collection.

item.title: Helldivers 2 is getting a mech-themed Warbond that adds two new exosuits—one of which carries a shield and a flak cannon
item.content:encoded: Exo Experts arrives on April 28.

item.title: The Alice: Madness Returns dev team 'made history,' American McGee says: It was 'the first team ever to tell EA *** and (kinda) get away with it'
item.content:encoded: Is this why we never got Alice 3? Probably not, but it's fun to think about.

item.title: I can't stop winning with this Vampire Crawlers build that basically plays itself
item.content:encoded: If you want to pulverize your enemies with endless bones, this Mortaccio build is for you.

item.title: I don't understand how Final Fantasy 14 can do a crossover with acclaimed anime Neon Genesis Evangelion and I'm scared to find out
item.content:encoded: Get in the DPS queue, Shinji.

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem has sold 7 million copies in 2 months—a milestone that took the RE4 remake a year
item.content:encoded: Capcom celebrated the milestone with two delightful cakes.

item.title: Developers of Steam Next Fest's wildly popular robot wizard cowboy shooter say its cowboy robots are also wizards because 'magic is always cool'
item.content:encoded: Hard to argue with that.

item.title: The release date for Path of Exile 2's next expansion couldn't be better for action RPG fans planning to play Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred first
item.content:encoded: This works out perfectly.

item.title: After over 3 years of running like dogwater on Steam Deck, one of my favorite RPGs has finally earned its Verified badge
item.content:encoded: I hope this is no delusion.

item.title: Fable creator says it's 'a real shame' the reboot is dropping the horns-or-halo morality system
item.content:encoded: Peter Molyneux is an old school guy, and he likes old school systems.

item.title: PSA: Crimson Desert's new camera settings can make the game look like Baldur's Gate 3
item.content:encoded: I wouldn't recommend fighting in isometric view, however.

item.title: The best possible fantasy author is writing a dark, tragic prequel novel for our beloved Baldur's Gate 3 boy Astarion
item.content:encoded: Wildly prolific fantasy and horror author T. Kingfisher just got announced as the writer of an Astarion backstory novel coming this year.

item.title: 'We don't have to fire 1000 people to keep it working': Facepunch Studios says paying s&box game developers is sustainable, with '$500,000 paid out to date'
item.content:encoded: Developers can also export their games standalone to Steam: "No hidden percentages, no rug pulls, your work is yours."

item.title: The Mission: Impossible guy is making a Battlefield movie, and Michael B. Jordan might star in it
item.content:encoded: This was bound to happen.

item.title: This composer just remade the entire soundtrack of the first Elder Scrolls game: 'It really gives you a sense of wonder and adventure'
item.content:encoded: "Arena has always been a game that I hold close to my heart,"

item.title: This Skyrim mod that makes NPCs AI chatterboxes just got a massive overhaul
item.content:encoded: "I am floored by this mod."

item.title: Nvidia rolls out GPT-5.5-based Codex to 10,000 of its employees, who apparently all think it's 'mind-blowing' and 'life-changing'
item.content:encoded: Go on, let me hear what the grumpy office admin really thinks.

item.title: After shaking Steam's servers with Baldur's Gate 3's launch, Larian publishing chief says 'I hope we absolutely demolish it next time'
item.content:encoded: Baldur's Gate 3 hammered Steam hard when it launched in 2023, but not hard enough for Michael Douse.

item.title: 'I basically sprinkle water drops on top of tissue paper': One redditor's quest to cool their Mac mini
item.content:encoded: Cursed.

item.title: After a slow start, Last Flag developer says you can't become the next big hit just by ticking boxes: 'It’s a slippery slope'
item.content:encoded: And Arc Raiders' lead developer agrees.

item.title: Tekken players have spent years asking for FF7's Tifa only for rumours to suggest she's been poached by the biggest competition
item.content:encoded: Capcom has the chance to do the funniest thing ever here.

item.title: My favorite RPG of 2026 put an impossible challenge in the second room to teach you not to save scum: 'I am your DM, trust me'
item.content:encoded: "It's a bunch of different stuff stolen from Fallout, obviously, like all good things."

item.title: Attention keyboard nerds: This website lets you hear the sound of 36 different mechanical keebs, switches, and more as you type
item.content:encoded: Most of them go "clickety clack." Sorry for spoilers.

item.title: White House claim that China is 'engaged in deliberate, industrial-scale campaigns to distil US frontier AI systems' called 'pure slander' by Chinese embassy
item.content:encoded: A memo seen by the Financial Times places the blame on "foreign entities, principally based in China."

item.title: Nextorage unveils fresh new gaming SSDs, but they only come with a one-year warranty
item.content:encoded: Has the memory supply crisis claimed another victim?

item.title: Gas power projects for just 11 US data center 'campuses' could emit more greenhouse gases than entire countries, according to report
item.content:encoded: "That terrifies me in a lot of ways."

item.title: Good news Silent Hill heads, Townfall is bringing firearms back as the devs promise combat and stealth will be on 'equal footing'
item.content:encoded: "What I really enjoy about melee combat is just how frantic it is."

item.title: Mass Effect devs have been practically radio silent for over 5 years because there's 'not a lot of time for tease'
item.content:encoded: It's coming. Eventually.

item.title: Final Fantasy 14's patch notes sneak-peek is Square Enix's classic formula of exciting quality-of-life changes and weirdly archaic systems
